data.long_meaning: A devotee or follower of Hanif, an early Islamic monotheist. Hanif was known for his sincere belief in Allah and rejection of idolatry. The name Hanifiyyah carries the meaning “Follower of Hanif” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hanifiyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of hanif and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes sincere devotion and rejection of false gods.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hanifiyyah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.spiritual_significance: Hanifiyyah represents a spiritual commitment to purity of faith and devotion to Allah without any intermediaries or idols. The term carries a deep spiritual significance as it inspires believers to strive towards sincere devotion and unwavering faith in the One and Only Allah.
